sudoku.title: Sudoku
sudoku.description: Fill the 9×9 grid with numbers 1-9 without repeating!

howToPlay.title: How to Play
items: Click/tap an empty cell to select it
Use the number pad or keyboard (1-9) to enter a number
Toggle notes mode to write small candidate numbers
Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain unique numbers

tips.title: Strategy Tips
items: Start with cells that have the most constraints
Use notes to track candidate numbers effectively
Check each row/column/box for missing numbers
Use the hint button to reveal one cell when stuck

whatIs.title: What is Sudoku?
whatIs.description: Sudoku is a logic-based number puzzle played on a 9×9 grid. The goal is to fill every row, column, and 3×3 box with the digits 1–9, each appearing exactly once. One of the world's most popular puzzles, it sharpens concentration and logical thinking. Multiple difficulty levels from beginner to expert are available.

items.q: Does every Sudoku puzzle have only one solution?
items.a: Yes. A properly generated Sudoku puzzle has exactly one unique solution, solvable purely through logical deduction.

items.q: Can I get a hint if I'm stuck?
items.a: Yes. Using the hint feature reveals one correct answer in an empty cell, though it may deduct points from your score.

items.q: How do I correct a wrong entry?
items.a: Click on the incorrect cell again to change it. Use the pencil/notes mode to jot down candidate numbers in small text without committing to an answer.
